data.name: Nakheel
data.gender_notes: Nakheel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Nakheel is derived from the Arabic word for palm tree. It symbolizes strength, stability, and growth. In the Quran, the palm tree is mentioned as a sign of Allah's power and mercy. The name Nakheel carries the meaning “Palm tree” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nakheel usually hope their child will grow to embody palm tree and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and stability rooted in faith.
data.etymology: Nakheel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Palm tree.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nakheel total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: نخيل
in_arabic.long_meaning: النخيل الكثير الأفنان الخضراء، مشتق من نَخَلٍ وهو الفعل الذي يعني التخلق أو الانتشار، ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة يس: ﴿وَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا نَخْلًا رَاسِيَاتٍ﴾، يرمز إلى الخصب والنماء، ويحمل دلالات روحية تتعلق بالنماء والتطور الروحي.

in_urdu.name: نخیل
in_urdu.meaning: بہت سارے سبز پتے والا کھجور کا درخت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نخیل کا مطلب ہے بہت سارے سبز پتے والا کھجور کا درخت، جو عربی جڑ ن-خ-ل سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کھجور کے درخت کی بہتات یا پھیلاؤ کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر قرآن میں ذکر ہونے کی وجہ سے، جیسے سورة يس میں: ﴿وَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا نَخْلًا رَاسِيَاتٍ﴾، جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں روحانی نمو اور خوشحالی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नखील
in_hindi.meaning: बहुत सारे हरे पत्ते वाला खजूर का पेड़
in_hindi.long_meaning: नखील का अर्थ है बहुत सारे हरे पत्ते वाला खजूर का पेड़, जो अरबी मूल न-خ-ल से व्युत्पन्न है, जो खजूर के पेड़ की बहुतायत या प्रसार को दर्शाता है, इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है, विशेष रूप से कुरआन में उल्लेख के कारण, जैसे सूरा यासीन में: ﴿وَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا نَخْلًا رَاسِيَاتٍ﴾, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में आध्यात्मिक विकास और समृद्धि का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: نخيل
in_pashto.meaning: ډیری شنه پاڼي لرونکی خرما ونه
in_pashto.long_meaning: نخيل پدې مانا ډیری شنه پاڼي لرونکی خرما ونه، چي د عربيې ريښې ن-خ-ل څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کومکي د خرما د ونې ډیر والي یا خپراوي څرګندوي، په افغان او پښتون دود کې مهم دی، په ځانګړي ډول د قرآن کريم د ذکر له امله، لکه د سورة يس په آيت کې: ﴿وَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا نَخْلًا رَاسِيَاتٍ﴾، د روحاني ودې او سوکالۍ نښه ده.

in_english.name: Nakheel
in_english.meaning: Palm tree with many green leaves
in_english.long_meaning: Nakheel, derived from the Arabic root ن-خ-ل (n-kh-l), signifies a palm tree with many green leaves, symbolizing abundance and spiritual growth, mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Yasin: ﴿وَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا نَخْلًا رَاسِيَاتٍ﴾, reflecting prosperity and divine blessings, widely used across Muslim cultures for its positive connotations.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nakheel holds strong cultural significance in the Islamic world, especially in the Arabian Peninsula where the palm tree is abundant. Palm trees have been used for centuries for essential resources, including food, shelter, and economic value through dates and coconuts. The name Nakheel also has a connection to the Dubai real estate company of the same name, which has become a symbol of modern and luxurious urban development.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the palm tree is mentioned in various stories and teachings. It represents a source of life and vitality, symbolizing the bountiful blessings of Allah. The green fronds and ripe dates of the palm tree also signify growth, renewal, and the pleasures of the hereafter. The early historical name for the city of Mecca (Makkah) was actually assumed to mean 'the place of many palm trees'. Thus, the name Nakheel is deeply spiritual, representing growth, strength, and blessings from Allah.
